title: Art Type
description: An album cover made of its own pixels. Move across it or drag the scrubber and the pixels peel off in one clean left-to-right wave, take on the cover's darkest ink in flight and settle into the title, which resolves into crisp type with the year beneath. Move back and the picture puts itself together again.
intent: One morph finished to the edge: a particle reassignment from cover pixels to title glyphs, swept left to right, with the real artwork and real type at both ends so the rest states are always sharp.
